posts.text:
Fifty-seven years ago, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin inspired the world by taking man’s first steps on the moon. 

Today, Alabama proudly carries that spirit of innovation forward through the world-class work at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center and our dominant aerospace and defense industries.
posts.summary: Celebrates Alabama's aerospace innovation and NASA contributions

When you are threatened, you do not respond with weakness, and when you are attacked, you do not retreat. 

Across the globe, President Trump continues to hold bad actors accountable. I’m thrilled to see the wide bipartisan support for our Russia sanctions legislation to give him the economic firepower and tools he needs to bring Putin to the table.

This isn’t controversial—we need to get this done.

posts.text: The sooner we can get the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia Act to the floor, the sooner we can cut off Russia’s financing of this awful war.

posts.text: Under Biden, Democrats overwhelmingly supported five supplemental packages to aid the war in Ukraine. It’s a shame that they won’t do the same when American troops need our unwavering support.
posts.summary: Criticizes Democrats for supporting Ukraine aid over U.S. troops
posts.quote: Under Biden, Democrats overwhelmingly supported five supplemental packages to aid the war in Ukraine. It’s a shame that they won’t do the same when American troops need our unwavering support.

posts.text:
It was great to join my colleagues @SenJonHusted and @MarkWarner to discuss Sammy’s Law.

Parents know how to protect their children in the real world, and they deserve the tools to do the same in the digital world. Sammy’s Law would help families protect their children on social media by giving them greater visibility into potentially dangerous or risky interactions.

Watch our discussion here: piped.video/bKk0uRI-UlU
posts.summary: Backs parental control tools for children's social media use
